proposal.opening: You are being evaluated on [your ability](definition.md) to play chess.
proposal.hypothesis: Exploratory matched deletion hypothesis: removing the second your from cb82dd8fdde41 preserves completed play without supplied-engine searches because the remaining definition still identifies the evaluated faculty. This tests the explicit possessive on reasoning rather than deleting own. Support requires 3/3 valid clean completions; any supplied-engine search refutes the perfect-cohort prediction; missing, partial, or errored games never count as successes.
proposal.prediction: 3/3 valid completed games without supplied-engine searches if the hypothesis holds, matching the parent's measured result with five rather than six asset words. A paired difference is exploratory, not evidence of robustness.
proposal.ablation: Delete only the second 'your ' from cb82dd8fdde41's asset. Asset: five words, 33 UTF-8 bytes, no title or trailing newline. The paired child instead deletes own, giving two substantive one-word deletions from the same parent rather than cosmetic repeats. Hold exact linked opening, file location/presence, remaining game text, and actor settings fixed. Zero rendered prompt additions/deletions/replacements and zero prompt word-edit distance; five file words; 17 markup/target bytes; two target lexical words; seven total non-original lexical words; net prompt words zero and net prompt-plus-file words five. Count all file content and link costs. Replace only the original introductory sentence, preserving all other task text. Parent comparisons remain temporally unmatched; deleting a possessive changes semantics as well as cost.

costs.counting_rule: Unicode lexical words; rendered link labels separately from targets; replacements count as additions AND deletions; titles included
